question: Does the cover-page authorization clause—which identifies a single discharge at Outfall 001 and incorporates effluent limitations, monitoring requirements, and other conditions from Parts I–IV—establish that those Parts I–IV obligations apply only to Outfall 001, or to every discharge point addressed in Parts I–IV?
semantic_arguments: singular reference to 'the discharge' with explicit enumeration of Outfall 001 and its coordinates on the cover page
incorporation of effluent limitations, monitoring requirements, and other conditions from Parts I, II, III, and IV without restating outfall scope in the target span
purposes requiring evaluation across multiple discharge points, parameters, and monitoring periods where applicability must be established from available evidence
notes: A reading that treats Outfall 001 as the sole authorized discharge point would restrict which measurement/limit pairs, monitoring requirements, and missing-evidence cases must be evaluated, whereas a reading that treats Parts I–IV as independently scoping all listed discharge points would expand the required computation.
